description: A small chibi pixel art head seen from the front, bald, with long pointed ears and big violet eyes. Paint only inside the white of the mask, across the eyes: a black masquerade half-mask shaped like a bat with its wings spread out to both sides past the face, a thin crimson trim along its edges and two tiny silver studs, with two open eye holes around the eyes. The eyes must stay visible through it. Keep the same chunky pixel size, the same thick dark outline and the same flat shading with a few tones per colour. The rest of the face, the head and the ears stay exactly as they are, nothing else added, transparent background.
